responsibility: This header defines GCC’s opt_problem and opt_wrapper abstractions for optimization routines that want to return ordinary success/failure values while optionally carrying detailed missed-optimization context when dumping is enabled. It declares the opt_problem container around optinfo plus the opt_result, opt_pointer_wrapper, and opt_tree wrapper APIs that create, propagate, and later emit failure descriptions without changing the in-memory representation of the wrapped bool or pointer results used throughout optimization code.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opt_problem API and the opt_wrapper/opt_result/opt_pointer_wrapper/opt_tree types that optimization code uses to propagate failures. Unlike opt-problem.cc, it does not manage dumping state or emit messages itself; it provides the inline wrappers, type abstractions, and class declarations consumed by other files.
